settings.title: Fair valuations
settings.body: We price based on condition, demand, and the current market — no algorithms, no low-ball offers.

settings.title: We sort the shipping
settings.body: Nearby? We'll collect for free. Further away? We'll email you a prepaid label — no cost to you.

settings.title: Quick turnaround
settings.body: Quote within 2 working days. Payment within 1–2 days of receiving and checking your games.

settings.title: Send your list
settings.body: Fill in the form with the games you'd like to trade. Include condition and any missing components — rough is fine.

settings.title: Receive a quote
settings.body: We'll review your list and come back within 2 working days with a fair valuation and your payment options.

settings.title: Agree and ship
settings.body: Happy with the offer? Tell us your postcode and preference — local collection or prepaid label — and we'll take it from there.

settings.title: Get paid
settings.body: Games arrive, we check them, we pay within 1–2 working days. Choose bank transfer, PayPal, or store credit with a bonus.

settings.question: What condition do games need to be in?
settings.answer: Good or better — minor shelf wear, small scuffs on the box, and light card wear are all fine. We can't take games with missing components, water damage, or heavy writing-in. If you're unsure, list it anyway and we'll advise.

settings.question: Do I have to pay for shipping?
settings.answer: No. If you're nearby we'll collect in person at no cost. If you're further away we'll send you a prepaid label — you just need to box the games up and drop them at a collection point.

settings.question: Can I trade expansions without the base game?
settings.answer: Yes — we'll consider expansions on their own. Just note which base game they belong to and we'll factor that into the quote.

settings.question: How is the value calculated?
settings.answer: We look at the game's condition, current demand, recent secondary-market prices, and our own stock levels. Store credit quotes come with a 10–15% bonus over the cash equivalent.

settings.question: What if I'm not happy with the quote?
settings.answer: No obligation — you can turn it down at any point before you ship. We'll never pressure you and we'll never cherry-pick; we quote on everything you list.

settings.question: How many games can I trade in at once?
settings.answer: As many as you like. If you're clearing a large collection, mention it in the form and we'll discuss the best way to handle it — we may be able to arrange collection even if you're further away.
